s: tides (periodic change of the sea level)
Gezeiten.et: From the plural of Middle High German gezīt (“particular time, such as a feast or prayer time”), from Old High German gizit (“passage of time”), from gi- + zit. The modern sense is loaned from cognate Middle Low German getīde, whence also Tide. Related to Zeit…

s: signed; usually abbreviated as gez., which see for more
brood, spawn (collective result of some reproductive process)
brood, ilk, vermin (collective of people or animals sharing a negatively regarded ideology, practice or classification)
Gezücht.et: Inherited from Middle High German gezühte, equivalent to ge- + Zucht.
